Application Data.NAME: Smith & Johnson Accounting Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Johnson Accounting Services provides comprehensive accounting and financial consulting services, specializing in tax preparation, bookkeeping, and financial advisory. Our team of certified public accountants (CPAs) adheres to strict regulatory compliance and maintains a clean record with no disciplinary actions. We prioritize data security, employing advanced cybersecurity measures including multi-factor authentication and end-to-end encryption to protect sensitive client information. Regular audits and robust internal controls ensure the integrity and accuracy of our financial reporting practices. We aim to deliver exceptional service while effectively managing risks associated with professional errors and omissions, ensuring our clients' financial success and peace of mind.
